description: This file defines the OA_DB class responsible for managing database connections, DSN creation, schema setup, and related database utilities within the Revive Adserver project. It uses PEAR::MDB2 for database abstraction and includes methods for singleton connection handling, database creation/deletion, schema and charset setup, and sequence name generation.

classes.name: OA_DB
classes.description: A class for creating and managing database connections, including DSN handling, schema setup, charset configuration, and database creation/deletion, primarily using PEAR::MDB2.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Returns a singleton database connection resource, establishing a new connection if necessary, with support for SSL, charset, schema, and debugging options.

methods.name: getDatatypeMapOptions
methods.description: Retrieves custom datatype and nativetype mappings based on project-specific configuration files.

methods.name: getDsn
methods.description: Constructs and returns a DSN string based on the global configuration.

methods.name: getDsnOptions
methods.description: Returns driver-specific options such as SSL and compression settings for database connection.

methods.name: changeDatabase
methods.description: Switches the connection to a different database by name using the existing configuration.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database on the server, handling quoting and error checking.

methods.name: createFunctions
methods.description: Sets up required database functions, including loading language support for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: _createLanguage
methods.description: Loads a procedural language into PostgreSQL if not already present.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops a specified database and disconnects related connections.

methods.name: _getDefaultDsn
methods.description: Returns a DSN string for the default database (without a specific database name).

methods.name: setCaseSensitive
methods.description: Configures MDB2 options for case-sensitive table and column names.

methods.name: disableCaseSensitive
methods.description: Restores MDB2 options for case-insensitive table and column names.

methods.name: setSchema
methods.description: Sets the PostgreSQL search path schema, creating it if necessary, and sets up functions.

methods.name: setCharset
methods.description: Configures the client charset for the database connection.

methods.name: getSequenceName
methods.description: Generates a sequence name for PostgreSQL or returns the table name for MySQL.

methods.name: setQuoteIdentifier
methods.description: Configures MDB2 to quote identifiers with appropriate quotes for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: disabledQuoteIdentifier
methods.description: Disables identifier quoting in MDB2.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects a specific database connection identified by DSN.

methods.name: disconnectAll
methods.description: Disconnects all active database connections.

methods.name: validateTableName
methods.description: Validates a table name against illegal characters and database-specific rules.
